description.zh: 默认false，传入true 则使用置顶/定坑侧逻辑，但是必须在body中传入 sceneId
description.en: The default value is false. Set this parameter to true to use the logic for pinning items to the top or to a fixed position. If you set this parameter to true, you must also specify sceneId in the request body.

description.en: Specifies whether to include InvalidDetail in the response for pinning or fixed-position logic. This parameter is used for queries of the itemId:itemType type.
